payload.claim: Acceptance criterion 2 requires the refusal reason to 'name the cause' (one of four distinct causes: no task, no waiting task, no branch, no pushed sha), but `test_a_stack_order_refuses_a_parent_it_cannot_stack_on_and_names_the_remedy` never checks the distinguishing cause text for the three cases sharing the `_RUN_TO_PR_FIRST` remedy (TB-NOTASK, TB-NOPUSH, TB-NOBRANCH, TB-NEWESTNOPUSH at tests/test_scheduler.py:2481-2501). It only asserts the dep id (which the base 'depends_on {dep}' template already contains, independent of the cause) and the shared remedy string. Changing line 836's cause text from "{dep}'s newest waiting task records no branch" to the wrong "{dep} has no task recorded" keeps every one of those assertions green while the reason now lies about why the parent failed to qualify. This matches the measured gate result ('witness: fail — 1 of 2 witness(es) survived their own mutant'): the mutant targeting this cause-selection logic is not actually killed by the test.
